subject.title: fix(ui): show workspace context in dashboard header

question: Should persistent active-agent plus workspace context stay in the Dashboard breadcrumb/topbar on the current UI shell, or should maintainers follow the no-breadcrumb direction from the open maintainer draft before porting this PR?
rationale: Current main still lacks workspace header context, but this branch targets obsolete paths and overlaps a maintainer-authored draft that removes the same breadcrumb surface, so automation cannot choose the final UI contract.

options.title: Port Focused Breadcrumb
options.body: Preserve the focused active-agent/workspace breadcrumb, port it to ui/src/app and ui/src/components, rerun browser proof, and decide linked-issue closure scope after merge.

options.title: Adopt No-Breadcrumb Direction
options.body: Pause or close this branch if maintainers want the persistent context redesigned outside the topbar breadcrumb surface.

options.title: Broaden Before Landing
options.body: Require switch feedback, stronger live-target proof, or quick-switch behavior before any implementation closes the canonical request.

recommendation.title: Port Focused Breadcrumb
recommendation.body: Preserve the focused active-agent/workspace breadcrumb, port it to ui/src/app and ui/src/components, rerun browser proof, and decide linked-issue closure scope after merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The current shell/header files on main are attributed to Peter Steinberger's recent refactor commit, so he is the best available routing owner for the port-versus-redesign decision.
